name: @prism3/web-components
description: Prism3 components as Lit custom elements in the light DOM, rendering @prism3/css's markup and styled only by its CSS: <p3-button>, <p3-text-field> and <p3-password-field>.

scripts.generate: npx tsx generate.ts && npm run manifest
scripts.check:generated: npx tsx generate.ts --check && npx tsx check-manifest.ts
scripts.check:parity: npx tsx check-parity.ts && npx tsx check-parity-fields.ts && npx tsx check-token-parity.ts
scripts.test:browser: npm run -w @prism3/tokens build && npx tsx check-browser.ts && npx tsx check-browser-fields.ts && npx tsx check-entries.ts
